data.narrative:
Foundry Robotics, a Seed-stage robotics and manufacturing company founded by Adarsh Kulkarni, has raised $19M to date. The valuation universe comprises 9 private peers and 1 public comparable in the Robotics & Manufacturing sector, including companies such as Walden Robotics, Divergent, Exotec, and Locus Robotics.

Given the early stage and limited narrow-peer data, a peer-median approach proved inapplicable—only one same-stage comparable exists within the sector, falling short of the three-datapoint minimum for statistical reliability. Instead, the analysis relies on stage-progression methodology, applying a 2.5x step-up multiplier typical of Seed-to-next-stage transitions. Using the $19M total raised as a base value proxy yields an implied valuation of $48M.

The triangulation supports a valuation range of $40M to $55M, centered on $48M. The primary uncertainty stems from the sparse comparable dataset; broader peer validation at similar valuation tiers or stage transitions would strengthen conviction. Additionally, the analysis treats total raised as a proxy for post-money Seed valuation, which may require adjustment if prior rounds or option pool assumptions differ materially from market norms. A narrower range would benefit from additional same-stage or adjacent-stage transaction data.
